contract: GET runtime public.apiUrl+/public-sites/search with query,year,month,type; helper attaches SiteId

exact_anonymous_probes.scope: Known public tenant, year2026 and meetings type from literal vendor client. Previous unbounded-year request timed out25s; narrower supported year changes approach.

limits: Two live bounded requests timed out, second narrowed by documented year filter. No repeat of those probes.
No numeric meeting ID/date inferred from the renderer: only original same-source same-scope listing bytes bind an exact supplied result URL to its existing numeric identity.
Unmatched candidates remain explicit with preserved raw bytes, never invented slug IDs. Query semantics, full text, ranking, paging and catalog completeness are unverified.
Only declared meetings/title/slug/highlights/attachment context mapped. Policy administration and arbitrary document retrieval excluded.
